messages:
dana: initiating staged rollout deploy-2026-03-23-20pct with shadowing enabled (shadow=100% sample) to collect diffs. change window 14:00-15:00 UTC. dash: https://dash.re/canary/deploy-2026-03-23-20pct :rocket:

deploy-bot: deploy started  deploy-2026-03-23-20pct at 14:01 UTC. Canary target: 20% over 10m. Shadowing ON for sampled requests. Actions: pause | rollback --to <tag> | pin --version <tag> | shadow-adjust --pct <n>. Logs: https://logs.re/deploy-2026-03-23-20pct

aj: seeing rerank score drift in shadow diffs at 14:07 — quality delta noticeable, also small 5xx bump in live path (0.05% -> 0.6%). Snippet:
```
rerank_quality_delta_mean: -0.12
live_5xx_rate: 0.05 -> 0.6
```

sanjay: infra check: KV cache evictions up on pods handling long-history sessions (3/min -> 95/min). Memory pressure low, GC pauses small. Looks like longer KV footprints from new tokenizer offsets.

maria: option: pause lift and increase shadow sampling to 100% for a few minutes to validate diffs, or rollback. Thoughts?

aj: prefer to up shadow to 100% (full mirror) while holding canary at current 5% to avoid customer impact. If shadow shows consistent regressions, rollback.

dana: doing hold at 5% and bumping shadow sample to 100% for 5m. /deploy action pause && /deploy action shadow-adjust --pct 100

deploy-bot: actions queued. Canary paused at 5%. Shadow sample increased to 100% for 5m. Monitoring diff listeners.

aj: after 4m of full shadow, diffs show consistent rerank degradation for long-history queries and a rise in tail latency for embed calls. Marking as regressions in INC-2026-150.

sanjay: infra confirms KV evictions not abating for affected pods. Root cause likely tokenizer offsets + longer KV retention.

maria: consensus to rollback and pin stable v2.3.1 for the window. danA please execute rollback command.

dana: `/deploy rollback --to v2.3.1 --deploy-id deploy-2026-03-23-20pct --reason "shadow diffs + kv-eviction tail regressions"`

deploy-bot: rollback initiated for deploy-2026-03-23-20pct. Reverting canary traffic to v2.3.1. ETA ~90s. Pinned option available: `/deploy pin --version v2.3.1 --until 2026-03-23T15:00:00Z`

aj: post-rollback metrics look healthy, rerank diffs cleared. Good catch using shadowing.

sanjay: opening INC-2026-150 and linking traces. Will add a perf/regression test for tokenizer offsets.

maria: release-note addendum: "Aborted canary (deploy-2026-03-23-20pct). Rollback to v2.3.1 after shadow diffs revealed rerank and KV-cache regressions; investigation in INC-2026-150."

dana: pinning stable: `/deploy pin --version v2.3.1`

deploy-bot: v2.3.1 pinned until 2026-03-23T15:00:00Z. Incident INC-2026-150 created.

maria: stop/go summary: hold at 5%, increase shadowing to validate, shadow showed regression -> rollback + pin. Follow-ups assigned in the incident. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
